record_title: Deterministic character-sum pruning for no-hint elliptic-code key recovery
provenance: A deterministic finite-field character-sum refinement of the no-hint affine normalization step in arXiv:2609.17732.
limitations: The result improves the proved worst-case complexity of the affine-pair normalization stage, not necessarily the leading complexity of the complete structural attack. It is stated for characteristic greater than 3 and q at least 11 so that a rational non-2-torsion normalization point is guaranteed. No optimality claim is made for the survivor bound. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
